command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'STATUS_BEFORE'; git status --short; git stash push -u -m 'superseded sidebar Known Folder work already in main'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $after=@(git status --porcelain); if($after.Count -ne 0){$after|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}; throw 'Checkout not clean after fast-forward.'}; $head=git rev-parse HEAD; $origin=git rev-parse origin/main; Write-Output "SYNCED_HEAD=$head"; Write-Output "SYNCED_ORIGIN=$origin"; if($head -ne $origin){throw 'HEAD != origin/main'}; $top=git stash list -1; Write-Output "STASH_TOP=$top"; if($top -notlike '*superseded sidebar Known Folder work already in main*'){throw 'Expected superseded stash not found at top.'}; git stash drop 'stash@{0}'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'SUPERSEDED_STASH_DROPPED=True'; Write-Output 'STATUS_AFTER'; git status --short; Write-Output 'SYNCED_CLEAN=True'
